evidence: Static review of the frozen bytes; every element of the skill's check-15 procedure is present. (1) Pinned base: environment/Dockerfile:1 `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` (tag pin, not a digest; identical to the frozen template). (2) Runtime dependencies pre-installed at exact versions, globally, matching NODE_PATH: Dockerfile:3 `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules`, Dockerfile:9-12 `npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1`. The golden's only non-builtin requires are `express` and `better-sqlite3` (require scan of solution/app; the rest are crypto, fs, path, node:http, node:worker_threads and local modules), and solution/app/package.json:13-16 declares exactly those two at the same versions. (3) No run-time install: grep for npm install/ci, npx, apt-get, pip install, yarn, pnpm, curl, wget across solution/, tests/test.sh, tests/tools, instruction.md and environment/instructions returned nothing; solve.sh:35 only copies files; instruction.md:15 says `Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages` and integration.md:3-5 says the packages are `already available through NODE_PATH`. (4) Assets staged: Dockerfile:14-15 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` and `COPY assets/ /assets/`; both source directories exist in the build context; seed_data.json parses as a JSON object (sha256 1b390154...8bcf7, byte-equal to the copy the golden ships at solution/app/src/seed_data.json). (5) Dockerfile:16 `chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets`; Dockerfile:17-23 create /app, git-init it and commit only .gitkeep. (6) The agent Dockerfile does not COPY solution/ or tests/; task.toml has no docker_image and no allow_internet. (7) environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...467d1) and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template copies (diff empty), and tests/Dockerfile:20-21 carries the same two runtime pins. Observations that are not defects under the workbook: apt packages at Dockerfile:5-7 are unversioned (the deterministic sheet classes unpinned apt as a NOTE) and the base is pinned by tag rather than digest; both are template-controlled. Measurement limits: no build of the agent image from these frozen bytes is recorded in raw-evidence-index.json. Its entries are scripted golden runs inside the verifier image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair (server.log shows `[hireops] listening on 3000`), which shows the same two pinned packages resolve through NODE_PATH there, but it is not an agent-image build or run. Local hireops-agent:20261001-* images exist in `docker images`, but they are not hash-bound to this candidate and I did not build or start anything. The verdict is therefore a source-level Pass, not a measured build.
